justification: Both surfaces include some anthropomorphic imagery and incised linear markings, but these are very generic correspondences: A is dominated by a large rectangular field of repeated signs with small standing figures below or beside it, while B is a single large frontal schematic anthropomorphic form covered with geometric facial/body motifs. The biggest difference is that A presents an inscription-like panel with subsidiary human figures, whereas B’s decoration is organized as the body and face of one monumental figure.
